## Test Training Split
```{r}
set.seed(39748)
n <- nrow(dataset)
train_index <- sample(n, floor(0.8 * n))
training_data <- dataset[train_index, ]
testing_data  <- dataset[-train_index, ]
```

## MICE Setup
```{r}
method <- rep("pmm", ncol(training_data))
names(method) <- colnames(training_data)
method[categorical_vars] <- "polyreg"
method[binary_vars] <- "logreg"
method[outcome] <- ""  

num_imputations <- 25
imp <- mice(training_data, m = num_imputations, method = method, seed = 39748, printFlag = TRUE, maxit=10)
```

## Multiple Imputations Diagnostics

```{r}
densityplot(imp, ~ w2fat5yp)
densityplot(imp, ~ w3parqualmp)
densityplot(imp, ~ w4ghq12scr)
densityplot(imp, ~ w4concenyp)
```

```{r}
plot(imp, c("w3parqualmp", "w2fat5yp"))
```
## Convergence Analysis
```{r}
library('miceadds')

psrf_df <- Rhat.mice(imp)
ac_df <- convergence(imp, diagnostic = "ac", parameter = "mean")
conv_all <- convergence(imp, diagnostic = "all", parameter = "mean")
head(conv_all)
```
